deal.name: GreenLeaf Agro
deal.story: GreenLeaf Agro is a vertically integrated agriculture business supplying maize, beans and horticulture across the Eastern Province. Profitable for 6 consecutive years, the company is raising to expand cold-storage capacity and double export volumes.
deal.rationale: Six years of profitable trading with margins above 20% and no missed repayments. Verified statements cover 12 months; existing debt is small against appraised capacity.

about.description: Grows, cools and distributes fresh produce to Kigali retailers and hotels, with its own cold room in Gasabo.

audit.reconciliation_statement: Bank and mobile-money statements for July reconcile to the reported inflow, within the governed tolerance cited in the sealed report.

updates.summary: On plan · coupon repaid on time
updates.business_note: Sales held steady through the season; the cold-storage expansion is on schedule and the monthly coupon was paid on the 3rd.
updates.auditor_note: Bank and MoMo statements reconcile to the reported inflow; inventory count matched the sample within tolerance.

updates.summary: Watchlist · margin under plan for one month
updates.business_note: A late harvest pushed costs above plan this month. Orders for next month are already booked and cover the shortfall.
updates.auditor_note: Bank and MoMo statements reconcile to the reported inflow; inventory count matched the sample within tolerance.

deals.name: Sebeya Logistics
deals.story: Sebeya Logistics operates a modern fleet serving cross-border trade between Rwanda, Uganda and DRC. The raise funds fleet expansion and a new Musanze distribution hub.

deals.name: Volt Energy Rwanda
deals.story: Volt Energy installs and operates solar mini-grids for rural cooperatives. Recurring revenue from 9,000+ connections underpins a stable repayment profile.

deals.name: Akabanga Foods
deals.story: A heritage food manufacturer scaling its export line of sauces and condiments to regional supermarkets. Funds support new packaging lines and certification.

deals.name: Murakoze Tech
deals.story: Murakoze Tech builds payments infrastructure for SMEs. High-growth with strong margins; capital accelerates merchant acquisition across East Africa.

deals.name: Inzovu Coffee Co.
deals.story: Inzovu Coffee exports specialty Arabica to European roasters. The raise funds a new washing station and direct-trade relationships with 2,400 farmers.
